/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'EOF'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/main.tsx')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('<ThemeProvider theme=\"light\">', '<ThemeProvider theme=\"light\" lang=\"ru\" fallbackLang=\"en\">')
p.write_text(s)
print(s)
EOF"
/bin/bash -c "sed -i 's/<ThemeProvider theme=\"light\">/<ThemeProvider theme=\"light\" lang=\"ru\" fallbackLang=\"en\">/' src/main.tsx && cat src/main.tsx"
/bin/bash -c 'npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20'
